source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enable PXE on onboard NIC. Verify PXE boot function from each NIC port.
1. In BIOS setup, verify that all the PXE enabled NICs/LOMs show up in the boot sequence.
2. With all embedded and add-in NIC cards enabled, reboot the server and choose the PXE option.
3. Select the NIC port from the list for PXE boot.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. On board NIC ports should be shown in the boot sequence page when PXE function is enabled

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- PXE function test (IPv6): PXE IPv6 boot test requires the operator to enable PXE in BIOS, reboot, choose the PXE option and select the NIC port - a BIOS/boot-menu interactive flow the agent cannot drive.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: operator enables PXE in BIOS, boots the PXE option from each NIC port, and confirms the ports appear in the boot sequence; agent cannot drive the pre-OS PXE menu.

original_test_intent: Verify that every approved NIC exposes an IPv6 PXE firmware boot entry and that selecting each port reaches the intended IPv6 network-boot path.
original_method: An operator enables IPv6 PXE, observes and selects each firmware boot entry; supporting automation correlates the selected MAC/port with isolated Router Advertisement, DHCPv6 and boot-transfer evidence and checks final restoration.
manual_activity: The firmware boot-sequence observation and per-port IPv6 PXE selection are acceptance-critical operator actions; the agent only prepares and correlates network evidence.
required_inputs: Expected NIC/LOM list and physical/MAC mapping
Isolated IPv6 RA/DHCPv6/PXE service and boot image
Console/BMC access, reboot approval and restoration plan
safety_requirements: Confine RA and DHCPv6 advertisements/leases to the test segment and SUT.
Do not substitute OS IPv6 state or server traffic for firmware entry observation.
Record and restore PXE, boot-order and test IPv6 service state.
Stop on ambiguous mapping, unintended RA/DHCPv6 scope, wrong target, duplicate-address behavior or access loss; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only NIC/IPv6 baseline and RA/DHCPv6/PXE logs correlated by MAC, port and transaction to the operator selection.
Compare supporting boot exchange and final health/restoration without claiming the manual firmware result.
engineer_actions: Enable IPv6 PXE, inspect every firmware boot entry, select each port and record the boot outcome.
Restore boot/PXE settings, stop isolated IPv6 services and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its narrative correctly says the agent cannot drive the pre-OS menu; it provides no unsafe substitute command.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use approved read-only NIC/IPv6 collection and isolated RA/DHCPv6/PXE server logs only as supporting evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The IPv6 per-port scope and 40/40-minute values remain; firmware interaction stays manual.

modernized_recommendation.status: OPERATOR IPV6 PXE WITH RA/DHCPV6 CORRELATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture firmware entry and selected port on console, correlate it to the isolated IPv6 discovery/configuration and boot-transfer sequence, and restore all boot and test-network state.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Servers with firmware IPv6 PXE support on approved NICs.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC, NIC firmware, RA/DHCPv6/PXE service and image versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform firmware boot/PXE documentation and approved IPv6 PXE service design.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds IPv6-specific service isolation, MAC/port/transaction correlation and restoration evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Distinguishes firmware IPv6 PXE presentation from ordinary OS IPv6 connectivity and exposes wrong RA/DHCPv6 scope.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: NIC map and isolated IPv6 boot-service policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Pre-OS interaction remains manual; network logs cannot prove which firmware menu entry was presented or chosen.

project_override_considerations: A project may define RA versus DHCPv6 behavior, boot protocol and port subset, but must report exactly which ports and IPv6 path were tested.
expected_evidence: Approved NIC/MAC/port map and isolated IPv6 service readiness
Operator firmware boot-sequence captures for scoped NICs
Per-port selection correlated to RA, DHCPv6 and boot-transfer logs

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently requests IPv6 PXE entries and per-port firmware selection.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The manual procedure is concrete; the human-controlled core makes it MANUAL ONLY rather than blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps the manual boundary and adds IPv6-specific evidence and containment.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its RA/DHCPv6 scope, correlation and restoration safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates supporting automation and formal verdict from the manual acceptance.

review_improvement: Makes IPv6 control-plane isolation and correlation explicit so an unrelated RA, address or boot-server request cannot be misread as proof of the selected firmware path.
independent_technical_reasoning: IPv6 PXE depends on firmware UI selection plus IPv6 discovery/configuration and transfer; only the latter can be automated, while the source criterion requires the former to be observed by the operator.
